emma_finance: Flagging a month-end problem: AURORA-1 prepaid reserved capacity invoice appears to have been recognized in full on 2024-04-02 instead of being booked to deferred revenue. Need correction and sign-off before close.

suresh_acct: Can you drop the invoice id, contract term, and what the system posted vs expected? Ill validate and propose JE.

emma_finance: From billing export: INV-2024-0587, amount 120000, invoice_date 2024-04-02 (Dedicated reserved capacity). Contract term 12 months. Expected treatment: defer 120k and amortize 10k/mo. Actual: system revenue GL shows 120k recognized on 2024-04-02.

jordan_revops: Impact to April P&L is ~+120k; forecast variance explained. Ops recommends: reverse the recognized revenue in April, post deferred revenue liability, then run normal monthly amortization. If contract start is 4/1 we should include April amort in the schedule.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2024-0587 status: Paid 2024-04-05. Customer: AURORA-1. Creating billing ticket for deferral flag: BILL-4297.

auditor_bot: FYI: For audit trail, please include signed SOW, invoice PDF, payment remittance, and memo describing adjustment and timing. Put files in /GLClose/2024-04/AURORA-1.

suresh_acct: Draft JEs I propose for posting on 2024-04-30: 
1) Correction (to reverse full erroneous recognition): Dr Revenue 120,000 / Cr Deferred Revenue 120,000 (Narrative: reverse misposted prepay recognition).
2) If revenue start is 2024-04-01, post April amortization: Dr Deferred Revenue 10,000 / Cr Revenue 10,000. Net P&L effect for April = -110,000. Use accounts: Rev 4001, Deferred 2305.

emma_finance: Sales confirms SOW signed 2024-03-28 and term start 2024-04-01 (see attached PO PO-90877). Customer not disputing. I'll upload documents now.

maya_sales: Confirmed. Sales asked to commence services 4/1. No special billing entitlements beyond the PO.

suresh_acct: One control note: because payment has been applied to cash, the reversing entry will temporarily touch AR/cash only if the cash application was tied into revenue posting. Our suggested entries avoid AR changes by adjusting revenue <-> deferred. I'll post and tag JE batch.

jordan_revops: Ops follow-up: add a prepay-deferral validation during invoice creation so reserved capacity SKUs default to deferral. Billing ticket BILL-4297 assigned to billing-team.

emma_finance: Next steps: Suresh to post correction JE today, attach JE number, Emma to update revenue schedule and monthly close memo, Jordan to track billing ticket to completion. Please react :white_check_mark: here when you approve posting.

suresh_acct: :white_check_mark: Approved. Will post EOD and include batch/JE id in the GL folder.

emma_finance: Thanks all. I'll close this thread once JE is live and the P&L is updated.
